campaignScreen.inviteCopied: Invite link copied: paste it into the party chat.
campaignScreen.partyHint: tap a character for their sheet
campaignScreen.noCharacters: No characters in the party yet. Whoever joins with an invite picks their character.
campaignScreen.fightIdle: No combat in progress. It starts on its own when someone rolls Initiative.
campaignScreen.notFound: Campaign not found. You may no longer be part of it.

tableRules.title: Table rules
tableRules.introDm: Only the DM changes them; they apply to every character in the campaign. The 2024 rules (RAW) apply by default: change only what your table plays differently.
tableRules.introPlayer: The 2024 rules (RAW) all apply, except these.
tableRules.allRaw: This table plays by the 2024 rules (RAW).

flanking.title: Flanking
flanking.why: Two allies on opposite sides of an enemy. Optional in 2024.

nat1.title: Natural 1 on checks and saves
nat1.why: In 2024 a natural 1 only makes an attack roll miss.

fumbles.title: Fumble note
fumbles.why: A natural 1 on an attack adds a note to the fight's log.

deathSaves.title: Death saving throws
deathSaves.why: How many successes stabilize and how many failures kill (RAW: 3 and 3).

rest.title: Rest lengths
rest.why: RAW: a Short Rest is 1 hour, a Long Rest 8 hours.

exhaustion.why: RAW: up to level 6; each level takes 2 off D20 Tests and 5 ft off Speed.

hide.title: Hiding
hide.why: In 2024 hiding takes a check against DC 15.

points.title: Hero points and plot points
points.why: Dropped in 2024; add them if your table uses them.

systems.title: Optional systems
systems.why: The 2024 optional systems: switch on the ones you use.
